create_puzzle_dataset: run the script to generate 50 samples each of 10 reasoning_gym puzzle types and save as pickle
create_single_puzzle_data: use reasoning_gym.create_dataset with a puzzle name and keyword args to generate puzzle samples
export_dataframe_to_pickle: run the script to save the combined puzzle DataFrame as data/underthink_data.pkl
review_puzzle_config: review the puzzles dictionary to see which puzzle types and parameters are configured for dataset creation
summarize_underthink_data: summarize the underthink_data.pkl file containing 500 puzzle samples across 10 puzzle categories
